[[Commander (Narrator)|Commander]] dialogue on Wave 20 ([[Korblox Temple]], Mega & Impossible)}} }} ==Description== The '''Korblox Deathwalker''' was the final boss of [[The Hunt: Mega Edition Event]]. It also appears in [[The Classic Event]] missions as part of [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode. It has a high amount of health but a slow speed, the slowest out of all the enemies in the event. The '''Korblox Deathwalker''' has three abilities: #The first is ''Swing'' which makes it swing its scythe at towers in an obtuse arc, stunning towers for 4 seconds and dealing 1,000 damage to units. #Its second ability is ''Meteor'', which makes it conjure ten blue meteors around the map, which stun any tower caught in their explosions for 5 seconds and deal 500 damage to units caught in them. The explosions itself have an explosion radius of 4. #Its third ability is ''Laser Sweep'', where it fires a large death beam in a 360 angle from its body, stunning towers for 8 seconds and dealing 10,000 damage to units at a very fast tick. As the damage is tick based, it can deal far more damage than just the 10,000, even being capable of killing the [[Molten Monster]] by just using the ''Laser Sweep'' ability once. ==Logbook Description== "''The Deathwalker is one of the most powerful sorcerers in the history of The Korblox Empire. It transcends mortality, and the mere sight of it leaves enemies frozen in fear. After a battle, it is believed that the Deathwalker guides the fallen Korblox warriors into the afterlife while raising the souls of Redcliff soldiers, corrupting them into its devoted followers.''" ==Appearance== The '''Korblox Deathwalker''' is a large ghostly figure which only has skeleton arms and parts of legs. Its torso is replaced by a giant flame and it has no head, only blue flaming eyes. It wears a brown hood with a cape that has four black wings attached to it. On its arms it has blue shoulder-pads and armbands with grey accents. It also has a brown belt with blue crystals and a brown cloth attached to the back of it. It wields a large brown and grey scythe. ==Event Strategy== As this enemy only appears through [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode, no strategy section is made for its current version. Instead, a strategy section for the one that appeared without [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode in [[Korblox Temple]] is listed instead. ===''Easy/Mega Difficulty''=== *Towers with high DPS, like the [[Minigunner]], [[Turret]] or [[Pursuit]] can be used to take this down. **As it has a rather low amount of health, tower with lower DPS like the [[Militant]], [[Mortar]], [[Rocketeer]] or [[Medic]] can also be used to take it down. **The [[Commander]] and [[DJ Booth]] can be used to boost the statistics of your towers. *Stun immune towers can be used here, as they will be unaffected by the '''Korblox Deathwalker's''' stuns. ===''Impossible Difficulty''=== *High DPS towers such as the [[Minigunner]], [[Pursuit]], [[Ranger]], [[Turret]] and [[Accelerator]] are recommended to deal with the '''Korblox Deathwalker'''. **The [[Pursuit]] and [[Ranger]] are especially useful here, as they are immune to being stunned by it. **The [[Commander]] and [[DJ Booth]] can be used to boost the statistics of your towers. *The [[Medic]] can be used to cleanse stuns from your towers. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Animations}} KorbloxDeathwalkerFloat.gif|Walking animation (12 March
